title: Session entry
description: An entry of a conversation transcript that the E4 adapter appends through P1 session.append by the session handle. Entries are only appended; runtime compaction appends a summary entry. append is idempotent by the entry uuid. The core does not read the content: it keeps the session key (tenant, role, subject, conversation), the untrusted_seen mark and the periods (MEM-1, INJ-13). A session is content of the class content.

summary.description: true for a summary entry that runtime compaction appends.

content.description: Entry content; the runtime sets its shape, the core does not read it.
